arguments.command:
cd /workspace && for k in stream stream2 burst burst2 burst3; do
  /usr/bin/time -v python3 submission/scheduler.py < tmp/big_$k.json > tmp/big_${k}_out.json 2> tmp/t_$k.err || echo "FAILED $k"
  grep -E "Elapsed|Maximum resident" tmp/t_$k.err | tr '\n' ' '; echo " -> $k outsize=$(stat -c%s tmp/big_${k}_out.json)"
done
